basic_profile.bio: Avid reader and dog lover based in Berlin. I spend most of my free time exploring the city’s vibrant libraries and chasing down rare books. I work part-time at a local bookstore, which feeds my love for literature. I’m single, and my evenings are often spent browsing Reddit or reading fantasy novels. My typical online hours are late at night, as I enjoy the quiet and solitude for focused reading and discussion.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in literature and history, nurtured through a degree in English Literature and ongoing self-study. My job at a bookstore allows me to constantly expand my knowledge of authors and genres.
